description: This file contains end-to-end tests for the signup flow of a web application using Playwright. It includes tests for various signup methods, invite link handling, token-based signup, and related user flows.

methods.name: preventFlakyTest
methods.description: Checks if the 'Create your account' text is visible to prevent flaky tests.

methods.name: expectUserToBeAMemberOfOrganization
methods.description: Verifies that a user is a member of a specific organization with expected role and acceptance status.

methods.name: expectUserToBeAMemberOfTeam
methods.description: Verifies that a user is a member of a specific team with expected role and acceptance status.

methods.name: signupFromInviteLink
methods.description: Performs signup process from an invite link, filling email and password, and waits for onboarding URL.
